purpose: Isolate teacher pose consistency without changing inherited reference latent targets
alignment: One proper CA Kabsch transform per teacher conformation, applied to every backbone atom; no domain-wise fitting or reflection
shared_core: Mean teacher pLDDT >= 0.7 across coarse-valid samples; require at least max(32,ceil(0.5*length)) residues and nondegenerate geometry
fallback: Use all CA residues if the shared core is insufficient or degenerate; record every fallback; do not reject or reweight samples
reference_labels: Copy original raw_reference_z bit-for-bit; preserve every teacher sample, validity mask, cluster label and random draw policy
distribution: 50% raw reference, 50% uniformly chosen coarse-valid aligned teacher sample
training: Same initial head, seed, target order, flow-noise stream, optimizer and 2000-update schedule as previous empirical arm
controls: Existing matched raw-reference control and canonical empirical teacher arm; report both500/2000 endpoints
reconstruction_gate: Audit all8192 teacher latents; mean CA lDDT >=0.98 and coarse-validity loss <=0.01
rotation_control: Rotate/translate teacher coordinates, realign to the fixed reference, and verify recovered aligned coordinates and encoded latents
promotion: Existing valid-state coverage, quality and validity gates; only eligible effects get three-seed replication
test: No reserved confirmation or original independent-test scoring
speed_branch: Separately test learned paired-noise reflow after this label pipeline is running; do not confound pose and sampler changes
